title: Administrative Officer, UK Civil Service
summary: An entry-level role in a government department, usually handling cases, enquiries and records for the public. Many adverts for this grade ask for no formal qualifications and assess you on your application, tests and interview.

areas.label: How the Civil Service works
areas.why: Know who you are applying to join, what the values are and which grade to aim for.

areas.label: Finding and applying for jobs
areas.why: Find the right vacancies, read adverts properly and get through the stages to a start date.

areas.label: Behaviours, strengths and STAR examples
areas.why: Most of the assessment is about showing how you work. This is where home and unpaid experience becomes evidence.

areas.label: Civil Service tests
areas.why: Many campaigns include timed numerical, verbal and situational judgement tests.

areas.label: Interviews
areas.why: Prepare for a panel or video interview and for strengths-based questions.

areas.label: Checks, eligibility and joining
areas.why: Understand the checks an offer depends on, so nothing surprises you or holds up your start.

areas.label: Core office skills
areas.why: Plain English, emails, spreadsheets and handling information safely are used from the first day.
